notes: WAR! A seventh Arcade cabinet: a real-time strategy game. Conquer all eight regions from the world map - harvest BITS from code nodes, raise a Compiler Core base, train melee and ranged buddies, hold the line with zapper towers and firewalls, and raze the bug hives region by region. Tap to select, double-tap to select every buddy of a kind, tap to move and attack, drag to pan. Desktop mouse clicks are taps now, everywhere.
